instruction: Set the Reply-to address to "reply-team@outlook.com" for my email account in Thunderbird.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened Thunderbird Account Settings, navigated to identity section, typed a 2-line plain text signature, and completed the task in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Account Settings in Thunderbird, navigate identity settings panel, edit text fields (signature, organization, name), type multi-line text
metadata.task_rationale: Tests a different identity field (Reply-to Address) in the same Account Settings panel. Slightly different from signature since it's a single-line email field.
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the Reply-to Address field in Thunderbird account identity settings. Evaluator checks mail.identity.id1.reply_to in prefs.js equals 'reply-team@outlook.com'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches Thunderbird prefs.js file from the right profile path
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses user_pref lines and checks mail.identity.id1.reply_to, which is the correct preference key for Reply-to address
Expected value 'reply-team@outlook.com' exactly matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk
Parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns the rules dict, metric accesses rule.get('expect', {}) directly
Complete coverage: single instruction requirement fully verified by single evaluator check

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
